fixes.explanation: Dust and I go way back, since it piled on me for years in a junk drawer. Job doesn't pick dust, though. He says, "…I will come forth as gold." (Job 23:10) After the testing, he expects to come out as something precious.

Job says the opposite. "They carry the sheaves, but still go hungry." (Job 24:10) He says the same about the winepresses: they tread them "…but go thirsty." (Job 24:11) So no share of the harvest shows up in what he describes.
